Repository files navigation jevcut Turn a long video into short clips that stand on their own — for Shorts, Reels, TikTok, or just a highlights reel. One command in, ranked mp4s out. uv run jevcut run talk.mp4 model lemonfox [](/VBS2004/jevcut/blob/master/assets/demo.gif) jevcut transcribes the video, finds the moments worth clipping, decides exactly where each one starts and stops, drops anything that doesn't stand alone or turns out to be an ad, and writes ranked mp4s plus a page to watch them on, best first. What makes it different: code lists every place a clip could start or end — sentence ends, pauses, speaker changes — and never lets a model name a timestamp. Jev ([TypeSafe](https://docs.typesafe.ai/models.md)'s System One model) only ever judges the clip that one candidate edge would make, or picks among candidates code has already enumerated. See [What jevcut does differently](whatjevcutdoesdifferently). Measured, not asserted. On 38 handlabelled videos across 13 genres, jevcut beats five simpler approaches — scoring every sentence, fixed windows, padding the top sentence, and two that keep jevcut's own choice of moment but set the edges in code — on recall, on how often both edges land where a human would cut, and on precision. Full numbers in [BENCHMARKS.md](/VBS2004/jevcut/blob/master/BENCHMARKS.md); why each result came out the way it did is in [RESEARCH.md](/VBS2004/jevcut/blob/master/RESEARCH.md). It costs about 3¢ of Jev per hour of video ([What it costs](whatitcosts)); transcription is extra. Scope: v1 clips verbal content — podcasts, interviews, talks, panels, comedy, streams where people talk. The judge is Jev over transcript text, so a moment carrying no words (a crash, a scream, a stunt) is invisible to it by construction. That is a deliberate v1 boundary, not an oversight: see [issue 021](/VBS2004/jevcut/blob/master/issues/021eventclips.md). See [ROADMAP.md](/VBS20

items.descZh: jevcut 是一款创新的自动化视频剪辑工具，专门将播客、演讲、散文和喜剧等长视频转化为适合 Shorts、Reels 和 TikTok 的独立短片段。其独特的核心机制是通过代码枚举所有可能的剪辑边缘（如句末、停顿或说话人切换），再由 AI 模型 Jev 对这些候选切点进行精准判决，确定每个片段的最佳起止位置。在覆盖 13 种类型、包含 38 个手工标注视频的基准测试中，jevcut 在召回率、边缘对齐人类偏好及精确度上均显著优于五种基线方法，且每小时视频的 AI 判决成本仅约 3 美分。该工具高度适用于以口头言语为核心的视频场景，如播客、访谈、讲座和直播，但当前版本（v1）设计上刻意不处理无言语伴随的物理动作或音效瞬间。
items.quote: 代码列出了每一个可能的剪辑;人工智能法官选择每个剪辑的开始和结束。

items.title: Show HN: ZenMode OS, Open-source launcher: stay under your limit, save in gold
items.desc: description: ZenMode OS is an Android launcher built on one idea: make the healthier choice easier than the impulsive one. Not a blocker, not a detox, not a lecture about your screen time. title: ZenMode OS Quiet the noise, together. image: https://zenmodeos.com/assets/img/ogcard.png [Skip to content](main) Your attention is water in a jar. The attention economy drilled holes in it. Blockers plug the holes but leave the jar empty. Willpower refills it, but it's drained by noon. So we tried to do both, and put it where it can't be ignored: the home screen. _●_ KAMALRAAJ & SRINIVAS MET AT FOSS UNITED 2025 ANDROID · GPLv3 [](https://www.producthunt.com/products/zenmodeosandroidlauncher?embed=true&utm%5Fsource=badgefeatured&utm%5Fmedium=badge&utm%5Fcampaign=badgezenmodeosandroidlauncher) 01 · HOW THIS STARTED Two strangers, one text message. Hi HN, we're Kamalraaj and Srinivas. We met at the FOSS United annual event in 2025, swapped notes, and went back to our lives. A few months later one of us texted the other. That text became ZenMode. what if we built something for the phone addiction everyone has and nobody really admits to?DELIVERED · 2025 1. 2025 FOSS United We meet, swap notes, go home. 2. LATER, 2025 “What if…” One text. The project starts. 3. FEB 2026 Closed test Two weeks with real users. 4. MAR 2026 FOSS Hack About 100 users in the first 12 hours. 5. APR – JUN We lost steam Ordinary life reasons. It happens. 6. JUL 2026 → Back at it V3, built in the open. 02 · WHY A LAUNCHER Replace the home screen, don't nag on top of it. We picked the launcher on purpose. It's the one layer that sits between “I want to do X” and every app that would love to hijack that. Most wellbeing apps sit on top of your home screen and nag you. We wanted to _be_ the home screen. “I want to check the train time”YOUR INTENT ↓ ZenMode · the launcherTHE ONE LAYER IN BETWEEN ↓ FEEDREELSSHORTSBADGES EVERY APP THAT WANTS THE NEXT 40 MINUTES 03 · THE THESIS Plug the holes. Refill the jar. A jar of attention with holes drilled in its side. The water level changes with the approach you pick. FEEDS BADGES HOLES OPEN 5/5ATTENTION 0% THE ATTENTION ECONOMY BLOCKERS WILLPOWER ZENMODE That's why we (and everyone we know) uninstalled blockers within a week. Plugging and refilling have to happen in the same place. 04 · PLUGGING THE HOLES Type what you want. Don't browse a grid. ONE SEARCH BAR inst Instagram12 MIN LEFT TODAY Install settingsSETTING “inst” on the webWEB One search bar Apps, files, settings and the web. Type “inst” and you see 12 min left today next to Instagram, before you tap. 9:41 · NO BADGES Phone Messages Maps Camera Notes Bank Music Calendar A black home screen About 8 apps you choose. No badges, no widgets, nothing lit up asking to be tapped. BLOCK THE FEED, KEEP THE APP Instagram ReelsBLOCKED Instagram DMsOPEN YouTube ShortsBLOCKED YouTube searchOPEN PAUSE 30M A blocker with a scalpel Block Reels, keep DMs. Block Shorts, keep search. There's a Pause 30m button instead of “allow forever”, on purpose. 05 · REFILLING THE JAR Something to come back to that isn't a feed. WEEKLY · MONTHLY RECAP Instagram knocked _63 times_ on your loudest day. You opened it 4 times. KNOCKSOPENS ACCOUNTABILITY BUDDY Your stats sit next to theirs on the home screen. YOU 1h 12m today BUDDY 54m today Your buddy went over their limit today. If you break your limit, their phone shows one quiet toast. Nothing else happens. GOLD You set a daily ceiling and a stake. Every night you stay under it counts toward your own money going into a gold ETF. ₹25₹50₹100 MON · 1h 02m\+ ₹50 TUE · 2h 40m— WED · 48m\+ ₹50 You buy Gold BeES through Zerodha Kite. The units sit in your own demat account, and you can sell them on the exchange any time. ZenMode never touches your money. ZenMode is not a broker or an investment adviser. Gold BeES is markettraded and can fall. Read the [Gold Invest terms](../terms/goldinvest.html). 06 · THE HONEST PART Yes, it's the hook model. Run in reverse. The hook model, twice Four stages: trigger, action, reward, investment. The outer orange loop is what feeds pay out: badges, a feed, likes, followers. The inner green loop is what ZenMode pays out: your intent, one search, time and gold, a buddy and a recap. TRIGGER ACTION REWARD INVESTMENT a red badge open the feed variable likes your followers you decide one search time + gold a buddy WHAT FEEDS PAY OUTWHAT ZENMODE PAYS OUT Trigger, action, reward, investment. We know it's a little ironic. What's different is what it pays out in: your own time and your own money, which you keep even if you leave. Every piece can be turned off. We also know extrinsic rewards can crowd out intrinsic motivation. So the plan is for the gold to taper the longer you stick with it. THE PLAN · GOLD TAPERS, THE HABIT (WE HOPE) DOESN'T M1M2M3M4M5M6+ GOOD NIGHTS Whether that works is an open question. A longer study across buddy pairs is next. 07 · WHERE WE ARE About that asterisk. We ran a twoweek closed test in February, entered FOSS Hack 2026 in March, and got about 100 users in the first 12 hours. The asterisk: that version leaned on Firebase, so it wasn't fully open source. Where it stands now: the launcher, its contracts and a mock backend are public under GPLv3, and a clean clone builds and runs with no keys. Firebase and analytics live in one private module that implements the same interface. Account features like buddy pairing go through it; the launcher itself doesn't need it. app/ The launcher: search, home screen, blocker, recaps, the UI. GPLv3 · PUBLIC COMPILES AGAINST ↓ coreapi/ The interfaces. Every backend need is declared here first. GPLv3 · PUBLIC IMPLEMENTED BY ↓ coremock/ Default backend. Builds without any keys. GPLv3 · PUBLIC coreprivate/ Firebase, analytics, pairing. Maintainers only. CLOSED [Read the code on GitHub](https://github.com/ThammanaSrinivas/zenmode) 08 · ONE QUESTION FOR YOU What made you uninstall? We'd love feedback, especially from people who tried blocker
items.author: kr07_work
items.descZh: ZenMode OS 是一款由开发者 Kamalraaj 和 Srinivas 在 2025 年 FOSS United 活动上发起的 Android 开源启动器，旨在将“堵住注意力漏洞”与“正向反馈”整合在主屏幕层，温和对抗手机成瘾。其核心功能是取代传统桌面，强制用户通过单一搜索栏输入意图而非浏览应用网格，并提供精细化的 Feed 屏蔽（如屏蔽 Instagram Reels 但保留 DMs）与“暂停 30 分钟”机制。产品亮点包括直观的每日剩余时间提示（如“inst”旁显示“今天还剩 12 分钟”）、每周统计回顾（如显示“敲击 63 次，仅打开 4 次”），以及创新的黄金激励机制——用户每日屏幕时间未超标即可获得 ₹50 等额黄金 ETF 积分。此外，软件引入了“问责伙伴”静默提醒机制，并采用 GPLv3 开源架构，公测阶段首 12 小时便吸引了约 100 名用户。该产品特别适合希望以结构性、温和且带有经济激励方式减少屏幕时间的手机成瘾者及开源科技爱好者。
items.quote: ZenMode OS 是一款基于一个理念构建的 Android 启动器：让更健康的选择比冲动的选择更容易做到。

In fact, unless you set JEVLANG\_LOCAL\_PYTHON=1, even Python conditionals are evaluated by Jev. Setting this is otherwise known as "Luddite mode". How it works It's a source preprocessor built on Python's codec machinery (see [Python's preprocessor](https://pydong.org/articles/pythonspreprocessor/)). Each block header becomes a call into the runtime with the condition's text, its line number, and locals(): while __import__('jevlang.runtime').runtime.session(globals()).cond('while', 'there are bottles left', 3, locals()): At runtime the session gathers the variables in scope, the surrounding source (a few lines either side, with the current line marked) and how many times this line has been evaluated, and asks the backend for a decision. match statements are rewritten too. Jev is shown the subject and all the case patterns and picks one; each case becomes case (N, {...}): so that capture variables in real Python patterns are still bound: match the forecast: English subject case "snow": ... Python pattern case anything involving rain: ... English pattern case t if t 25: ... capture + guard: t is still bound case _: ... Use python m jevlang show FILE to see the rewritten source. Install With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/): uv sync .venv with jevlang, the TypeSafe SDK and pytest uv run python examples/bottles.py coding: jevlang files run with plain python uv run jevlang examples/weather.py or through the CLI uv sync installs jevlang in editable mode, including jevlang.pth, which registers the codec at startup, so edits under src/ take effect without reinstalling. With pip: pip install '.[jev]' installs the package and jevlang.pth python examples/bottles.py Without installing the .pth, run files through the CLI instead: python m jevlang examples/weather.py [args...] python m jevlang installpth [user] write jevlang.pth by hand Backends Pick one with $JEVLANG_BACKEND: name what it does fake Default while there's no API key. Offline and deterministic. Evaluates conditions that are valid Python as Python, and has keyword heuristics for English ask You are Jev: shows the full request on stderr and reads y/n (or a case number) from the terminal. jev The real Jev, via the [TypeSafe SDK](https://docs.typesafe.ai/sdk/python). Used by default when TYPESAFE\_API\_KEY or OPENROUTER\_API\_KEY is set. pkg.mod:factory Any object with a decide(request) Decision method. Using the real Jev export OPENROUTER_API_KEY=skor... or TYPESAFE_API_KEY from https://console.typesafe.ai/ JEVLANG_TRACE=1 uv run python examples/reviews.py [jev 1] reviews.py:9 match 'review' 0 @ 0.94 (p=0.95) 😀 Absolutely loved it, we're coming back next week [jev 2] reviews.py:9 match 'review' 1 @ 0.98 (p=0.99) 😠 Cold food, and the waiter rolled his eyes at us. [jev 3] reviews.py:9 match 'review' 2 @ 0.98 (p=0.98) 😐 It was fine, I guess. Examples examples/fizzbuzz.py is FizzBuzz with English conditions (if n is divisible by both three and five:). examples/vibe_sort.py bubblesorts foods by spiciness examples/tictactoe.py is tictactoe with Jev in charge of everything. Jev can't spot three in a row on a whole board, so it checks one line at a time, which comes to about 230 calls a game. It mostly works: Your move (X), e.g. 'top left' or 'middle': middle Jev plays the top left square. O X Your move (X), e.g. 'top left' or 'middle': upper left The top left square is taken. Your move (X), e.g. 'top left' or 'middle': bottom right corner Jev plays the top middle square. O O X
items.author: roywiggins
items.descZh: `jevlang` 是一款创新的 Python 预处理语言，其核心背景是将传统代码中的条件控制流（如 `if`、`while` 和 `match`）交由大语言模型 Jev 进行动态语义决策，允许开发者用自然英语编写逻辑。它通过 Python 编解码机制在底层将条件语句重写为运行时调用，并支持 fake、ask、jev 及自定义等多种后端，实现了自然语言与传统 Python 的无缝混合。其亮点在于，在井字棋示例中，Jev 每局游戏需进行约 230 次调用以逐行判定胜负，而在情感分析匹配中可达到 0.98 的高置信度（p=0.99）。此外，用户可通过 `uv` 或 `pip` 快速安装，并在需要时开启“卢德模式”（`JEVLANG_LOCAL_PYTHON=1`）回退到纯本地 Python 执行。该工具特别适用于大模型驱动的逻辑原型开发、自然语言编程教学（如英语条件排序和 FizzBuzz），以及需要动态 AI 决策的创意项目。
items.quote: Jevlang 是一种 Python 语言，其中所有的 if、elif、while 和 match（不包括三元表达式和列表推导式）都由 Jev 来决定，从而实现现代编码风格：条件判断不再依赖。

Standard library only, no dependencies, one file. from safe_fetch import fetch, SafeFetchError try: response = fetch("https://example.com") print(response["status"], response["headers"]["contenttype"]) except SafeFetchError as e: print("refused:", e) The problem Does your application fetch a URL that a user gave it? A webhook tester, a link preview, an avatar importer, an RSS reader, a "check my website" tool, an image proxy? Then this works, and it shouldn't: requests.get(user_supplied_url) user types http://169.254.169.254/latest/metadata/ That address is the cloud instance metadata service on AWS, GCP and Azure. Depending on configuration it hands back IAM credentials. Your server has access to it; the attacker doesn't — until your code fetches it for them and returns the response. This is ServerSide Request Forgery, and it's in the OWASP Top 10\. The same trick reaches 127.0.0.1:6379 (your Redis), 192.168.x.x (everything else on your network), and file:///etc/passwd if the library follows that scheme. The standard library will connect anywhere you point it. Nothing stops it by default. What this does fetch("http://169.254.169.254/latest/metadata/") SafeFetchError: '169.254.169.254' resolves to 169.254.169.254, which is a private or internal address. Specifically: Resolves the hostname and checks every returned address before connecting. Not just the first one — a hostname can resolve to several, and an attacker controlling DNS can return one public and one private address hoping you check the wrong one. Blocks private, loopback, linklocal, multicast, reserved and unspecified ranges, for both IPv4 and IPv6, including IPv4mapped IPv6 addresses. Revalidates every redirect hop. This is the step most implementations miss. A perfectly innocent public URL that responds 302 Location: http://169.254.169.254/ defeats any check performed only on the URL the user typed. Allows only http and https. file://, gopher:// and dict:// are standard SSRF escalation paths. Strips embedded credentials, query strings and fragments before the request goes out. Caps the response body so a malicious server can't stream you 40 GB. Install There's no package. It's one file with no dependencies — copy safe_fetch.py into your project. curl O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rehanfaisal/ssrfsafefetch/main/safe_fetch.py Requires Python 3.7+. API fetch(url, ...) fetch(url, timeout=8, max_redirects=5, max_body=65536, user_agent="safefetch/1.0.0", headers=None) Returns a dict: Key Meaning url Final URL after redirects status HTTP status code headers Response headers, keys lowercased body Response body as bytes, truncated to max\_body chain Every URL visited, in order elapsed\_ms Time for the final request Raises SafeFetchError for anything refused or failed. It never raises anything else for network conditions, so one except covers it. is_blocked_ip(ip_str) Returns True if an address should never be connected to on a user's behalf. Useful on its own if you're doing your own connecting. resolve_and_check(hostname) Resolves a hostname, raises SafeFetchError if any resolved address is internal, otherwise returns the address list. normalise_url(raw) Validates the scheme, strips credentials/query/fragment, adds https:// to a bare hostname. Raises SafeFetchError if the URL can't be made safe. What this does NOT protect against Being honest about the boundaries matters more than a longer feature list. DNS rebinding. There's a window between the check and the connection. An attacker controlling a DNS server with a onesecond TTL can return a public address for your check and a private one for your connection. Closing this completely means resolving once, connecting to the pinned IP, and passing the hostname separately for TLS SNI and the Host header. items.descZh: ssrfsafefetch 是一个纯 Python 标准库实现的 SSRF 防护工具，无需任何第三方依赖，仅需复制单个 safe_fetch.py 文件即可集成到项目中。它专门解决用户输入 URL 时可能触发的服务器端请求伪造漏洞，通过在连接前解析域名并检查所有返回的 IP 地址，阻止对内网、环回、链路本地等敏感地址的访问。核心机制包括对每次重定向跳转进行重新验证，确保攻击者无法通过 302 跳转绕过初始检查，同时仅允许 http 和 https 协议，自动剥离 URL 中的凭据、查询字符串和片段。其默认配置会限制响应体大小为 65536 字节，超时 8 秒，最多跟随 5 次重定向，兼顾安全性与实用性。该工具适用于 Webhook 接收器、链接预览生成、头像导入、RSS 阅读器、网站健康检查及图片代理等任何需要远程抓取用户指定链接的场景，能有效抵御针对云元数据服务、Redis、内部网络资源的攻击。
items.quote: 在Python中获取用户提供的URL而不打开SSRF漏洞。
